column1: # SandboxGuard whole decision (blacklist -> plain local path -> anti-cheat -> whitelist), checked by the Rust core
# (policy/file_access.rs) and by C++ Test 39 through vf_rust_decide_file_access.
# Paths are given as the C++ side passes them: canonical and lower-cased. Windows dir c:\windows, system dir
# "root" rows declare the allowed folders for every case below: root <TAB> path <TAB> rw|ro.
# Case rows: id <TAB> path <TAB> action (read|write) <TAB> anti-cheat flag (0|1) <TAB> expected verdict.
# Roots that must be ignored: a drive root would allow a whole disk, and a relative or UNC root is not a local folder.
# Allowed: inside a root, component by component.
# Flaw 1 (parent folder of the executable) and flaw 4 (working folder): no root covers them any more.
# Flaw 3: steamapps\common outside a real library.
# Flaw 5: a root is a folder, not a text prefix.
# Ignored roots: a drive root, a bare drive, a relative folder or a UNC folder never allows anything.
# Only plain local drive paths: device, UNC and dot segments are refused even inside a root.
# Anti-cheat: refused for writes even inside a root; reads do not look at it.
# The blacklist comes first, with its own verdicts (the full list is in sandbox_blacklist.tsv).
